start_here: Say to your AI: "Save the posts you liked on X to your files", with the account on which X connection to use. It keeps the posts in your files and says how many are new.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it reads X and keeps one file in your files.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Save the posts you liked on X to your files", and give it account (the X connection).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:save-x-likes and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read the answer: how many were read, how many are not kept yet, the newest key (give it back as since next time) and the file name in your files.
